overlay.rtest.scene.active: RTest section capture complete; preparing RT rendering
overlay.rtest.rendering.confirmed: RTest RT is rendering (first GPU frame complete, %s); press F8 to stop
overlay.rtest.backend.unavailable: RTest RT cannot start: Vulkan backend unavailable; see startup log
overlay.rtest.smokeTest.failed: RTest RT smoke test failed; see latest.log
screen.rtest.settings.title: RTest Vulkan Ray Tracing
screen.rtest.settings.sunColorTemperatur: Adjust direct sunlight color; lower is warmer, higher is cooler.
screen.rtest.settings.ambientColorTemper: Adjust sky/environment light color; lower is warmer, higher is cooler.
screen.rtest.settings.skyboxTextureEnabl: Retain the PNG skybox; blend over physical sky using texture opacity. Disabling hides only the PNG, not atmosphere, sun or volume lighting.
screen.rtest.settings.skyboxDaylightOpac: The dawn/dusk opacity curve overrides manual skybox opacity. Only changes the texture/physical-sky blend, not the atmospheric medium.
screen.rtest.settings.skyboxTextureOpaci: Manual PNG opacity when the curve is off: 0 is physical sky, 1 is texture. Ignored while the curve is enabled.
screen.rtest.settings.moonEnabled.tip: Enlarged moon with Minecraft direction and eight phases, lunar surface NEE, RGB transparent shadows and finite-segment scattering. Reflections/refractions share emitter radiance; independent of PNG opacity.
screen.rtest.settings.moonIntensity.tip: Scales lunar disk, surface NEE and volume energy together; default 0.06. Phase-dependent, zero at new moon. Artistic irradiance, not measured lux; does not brighten the entire scene through walls.
screen.rtest.settings.primeAtmosphereEna: Solar transmittance, four-wavelength scattering and finite-distance aerial perspective, with RGB transparent volume shadows. Full weather and lunar sky LUTs are not yet supported.
screen.rtest.settings.terrainLodFarCache: Far terrain proxy cache (seen terrain only)
Adjust direct sunlight, physical shadowing, and the sun path.
screen.rtest.settings.category.pathTraci: Adjust GI intensity and path layers; higher values can increase noise and GPU cost.
screen.rtest.settings.category.reconstru: Configure FSR3 temporal reconstruction and upscaling, terrain LOD and fluid capture.
Use NRD or raw RT; observe a few frames after switching.
screen.rtest.settings.sunIntensity.tip: Manual intensity for direct sunlight, physical sky and solar atmospheric scattering. Overridden when sky light level mode is enabled.
screen.rtest.settings.shadowStrength.tip: How strongly shadows affect direct sunlight.
screen.rtest.settings.volumetricLighting: Enable solar single scattering, aerial perspective and occluded light shafts. Disable to reduce GPU cost.
Physical atmosphere: scales solar in-scattering; transmittance is determined by the medium. Legacy mode: scales medium strength. Zero disables finite-distance effects.
screen.rtest.settings.volumetricFogDensi: Physical atmosphere: aerosol density (0–16x), rebuilding the medium and scattering LUT. Zero retains gas and Rayleigh scattering; higher density also attenuates direct light. Legacy mode: RGB fog density.
screen.rtest.settings.atmosphereAltitude: Physical atmosphere altitude above the ground reference, in metres. Updates sky coordinates without rebuilding the static medium.
screen.rtest.settings.volumetricLighting: Controls per-pixel aerial-perspective integration steps; Performance also skips the terrain-shadow query.
screen.rtest.settings.sunAngleOffset.tip: Offsets Minecraft's sun angle in time without changing the path direction.
screen.rtest.settings.sunAzimuthOffset.t: Rotates the sun path around the vertical axis: 0° = east-to-west, 90° = north-to-south.
screen.rtest.settings.dynamicEntityMvpEn: Upload capturable vanilla entity and block-entity geometry to dynamic BLAS/TLAS; unsupported layers are redrawn by vanilla after the RT output.
screen.rtest.settings.giBounces.tip: Number of GI continuation rays per path; the Primary ray is not counted.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrFormat.tip: LabPBR uses R=smoothness, G=metalness, B=porosity, A=emission; Classic and BedrockRTX use their native channel layouts.
Scales tangent-space normal-map XY and reconstructs a stable Z component.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrTextureAoEnable: Use the LabPBR normal-map blue channel as texture AO, affecting surface lighting.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrPorosityEnabled: Decode LabPBR porosity and reduce roughness under rain according to the material's wet response.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrEmissionStrengt: Multiplier for authored PBR emissive channels, up to 20x; the LabPBR alpha 255 sentinel remains non-emissive.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrPredefinedMetal: Decode LabPBR metal IDs 230–237 into predefined metal F0 (normal-incidence reflectance).
screen.rtest.settings.pbrTerrainCpuCaptu: Keep terrain sprite IDs so companion normal/specular textures can be sampled in RT; disabling restores compiled-mesh performance with neutral PBR fallback.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrParallaxEnabled: Run tangent-space parallax occlusion mapping from normal companion alpha height; this changes material UVs, not the coarse RT mesh.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrEntityParallaxE: Apply the same height-based UV displacement to entities, items, and block entities.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrParallaxDepth.t: Height displacement scale for parallax occlusion mapping; default 1. Higher values amplify surface depth.
Use asynchronous multi-level coarse LOD beyond the native terrain radius; transparent, fluid, emissive, and dynamic geometry stay native.
screen.rtest.settings.terrainLodFarCache: Keep immutable proxies for terrain that has left the client-loaded window; unknown chunks are never invented.
screen.rtest.settings.terrainLodGpuTrave: Build a GPU Hi-Z pyramid and select/cull static terrain TLAS instances; keep off until the Vulkan driver path is validated.
screen.rtest.settings.fluidRtEnabled.tip: Use fluid-aware RT capture for water and lava; disable to use the compiled-terrain fallback.
screen.rtest.settings.hdrEnabled.tip: Use the linear scRGB HDR path on native Wayland when the display exposes it; restart after changing this option.
screen.rtest.settings.fsrQuality.tip: FSR3 / DLSS render-resolution preset. Native AA uses DLAA for DLSS; High quality (75%) maps to the DLSS Quality mode. Exact DLSS dimensions come from NVIDIA SDK.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdEnabled.tip: Enable NRD 4.17.3 ReBLUR; disable to view raw RT.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdStrength.tip: Blend stochastic indirect and reflected lighting toward NRD; direct light and visible emission retain raw detail.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdHitDistanceReco: Reconstruct invalid hit distances; 3x3 is a balanced default, 5x5 is smoother, and off is for clean signals.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdDiffusePrepassB: Diffuse pre-pass radius; lower values retain detail, higher values reduce noise.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdSpecularPrepass: Specular pre-pass radius; raise it for noisy highlights, but excessive values spread highlights.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMinHitDistanceW: Minimum hit-distance weight in spatial filtering; higher values reduce shadow sensitivity.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMinBlurRadius.t: Minimum spatial blur radius after convergence.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMaxBlurRadius.t: Maximum spatial blur radius used with short history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdLobeAngleFracti: Normal-edge rejection sensitivity relative to the diffuse/specular lobe angle.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdRoughnessFracti: Roughness-edge rejection sensitivity; very low values can break material edges.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdPlaneDistanceSe: Allowed deviation from the local tangent plane; high values can ghost.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdFastHistoryClam: Color-box Sigma used when clamping main history to fast history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdFireflySuppress: Firefly suppression floor; lower values suppress more but can remove highlights.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdDisocclusionThr: Relative-depth disocclusion threshold; lower values reduce ghosting, higher values are more stable but can leak history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMaxAccumulatedF: Maximum NRD main-history frames; higher values stabilize noise but respond more slowly to changes.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMaxFastAccumula: Maximum NRD fast-history frames; it is clamped to the main history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdHistoryFixFrame: Number of spatially reconstructed frames after a history reset.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdAntiFirefly.tip: Suppress sparse bright samples from stochastic emissive hits. This adds one pass, while both large-radius prepasses remain off by default.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdSpecularPrepass: Use the specular pre-pass for motion estimation without feeding it into visible specular filtering.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdHistoryFixPixel: Sampling stride of the 5x5 history-fix kernel; lower values are steadier but can be softer.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdConvergenceScal: REBLUR convergence scale; higher values reduce spatial blur faster.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdConvergenceBase: Extra convergence base used during short history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdConvergencePerc: Maximum-history fraction affected by the short-history convergence base.
Maximum valid view-space distance; too low makes distant terrain look like sky.
screen.rtest.settings.category.output.de: Manage color mapping, HDR output and offline accumulation.
screen.rtest.settings.primeColorManageme: Apply gamut compression, highlight rolloff and hue repair to SDR output; disabled leaves linear BT.709 to sRGB encoding only.
screen.rtest.settings.hdrWideGamutEnable: Experimentally select a linear Rec.2020 surface; enable only when the compositor converts it correctly, then restart.
screen.rtest.settings.nativeColorDecodeE: Decode sRGB output from vanilla entities, UI, and effects into the HDR linear target; restart or reload resources after changing it.
screen.rtest.settings.offlineRender.tip: Freeze camera, scene, sun, weather, and atlas animation while a GPU RGBA32F running mean accumulates. Shortcut: Right Shift.
screen.rtest.settings.atmosphereDiagnost: Shows actual integrals at 100x diagnostic exposure. Shadow deficit is bright where direct scattering is occluded.
screen.rtest.settings.sunAngularRadiusDe: Larger radius widens penumbrae with blocker distance. Real Sun: about 0.27 degrees; try 1 degree. Integrated sunlight stays fixed.
screen.rtest.settings.sunShadowSamples.t: Solar samples per primary surface per frame. More samples reduce penumbra noise even without NRD, at additional ray cost.
screen.rtest.settings.sunDaylightIntensi: Sun intensity follows sky light level

Overrides manual solar intensity: normalized level 0 (raw sky light level 4) has intensity 3, level 15 is the daytime peak, with a smooth transition. Shared by direct light, physical sky and solar atmospheric scattering.
screen.rtest.settings.sunDaylightPeakInt: Solar intensity at sky light level 15 in automatic mode. Manual intensity is used when automatic mode is off.
screen.rtest.settings.category.post.desc: Exposure, bloom, color grading, lens effects and sharpening
screen.rtest.settings.post.enabled.tip: Enable exposure, depth of field, bloom, tone mapping and other display effects; disabled uses basic color output.
Defocus using scene depth; disable to reduce lens sampling cost.
screen.rtest.settings.post.autofocus.tip: Smoothly focus at the screen center, or disable to use manual focus distance.
Blend toward bloom with rain and depth as an additional screen effect.
screen.rtest.settings.post.toneMapping.t: SDR tone mapping. Native HDR preserves extended linear highlights instead of applying an SDR curve.
screen.rtest.settings.post.exposureEV.ti: Exposure compensation: +1 EV doubles linear brightness, including with automatic exposure.
screen.rtest.settings.post.autoExposureS: Zero disables automatic exposure; higher values compensate average brightness more strongly.
screen.rtest.settings.post.bloomIntensit: Strength of seven-level thresholdless bloom; water/lava add their own bloom amount.
screen.rtest.settings.post.vignetteStren: Darkening toward the image edges; zero disables vignette.
screen.rtest.settings.post.saturation.ti: Zero is grayscale, one preserves saturation, higher values intensify color.
screen.rtest.settings.post.gamma.tip: Display gamma: above one brightens midtones without changing ray transport.
screen.rtest.settings.post.colorTemperat: Color temperature tint: lower is warmer, higher is cooler; reference 6500 K.
screen.rtest.settings.post.focalLength.t: Lens focal length in meters; combines with focus distance and aperture to determine defocus.
screen.rtest.settings.post.apertureScale: A larger aperture increases defocus; the reference blur radius is 15 pixels.
screen.rtest.settings.post.manualFocusDe: Focus distance in meters, used when autofocus is disabled.
screen.rtest.settings.post.maxBlurRadius: Maximum defocus radius in display pixels; larger radii need more samples.
screen.rtest.settings.post.motionStrengt: Motion vector blur strength; zero disables it, camera cuts suppress the trail.
screen.rtest.settings.post.sharpenStreng: Final display sharpening; FSR sharpening is disabled while this pipeline is active.
screen.rtest.settings.post.chromaticR.ti: Radial red-channel shift about the image center; zero disables it.
screen.rtest.settings.post.chromaticG.ti: Radial green-channel shift about the image center; zero disables it.
screen.rtest.settings.post.chromaticB.ti: Radial blue-channel shift about the image center; zero disables it.
screen.rtest.settings.post.distortion.ti: Radial lens distortion; zero disables it, opposite signs bend in opposite directions.
screen.rtest.settings.post.rainBloomFogD: Depth attenuation of the rain screen effect, separate from physical aerosol density.
Automatic exposure metering weight toward the image center.
screen.rtest.settings.post.exposureTende: Metering brightness bias; values below one favor bright regions.
screen.rtest.settings.post.dofSamples.ti: Samples for defocus spreading and gathering; more reduces patterns at higher GPU cost.
screen.rtest.settings.post.motionSamples: Samples along each motion trail; more samples produce smoother motion blur.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdEntityEnabled.t: Apply NRD to models and their reflections; disable to avoid history trails, retaining sampling noise.
screen.rtest.settings.restirDirectEnable: Primary emissive lights only. Fresh visibility each frame; disabled by default.
screen.rtest.settings.restirSuffixEnable: Random replay with final gather after a rough static prefix. Extra tracing can increase GPU cost.
screen.rtest.settings.restirCandidates.t: More candidates improve initial light selection without one shadow ray per candidate.
screen.rtest.settings.restirSpatialNeigh: Previous-frame spatial proposals plus one reprojected temporal proposal.
screen.rtest.settings.restirGatherPrefix: More independently sampled prefixes reduce correlations but trace more paths.
screen.rtest.settings.post.agxMinEV.requ: Requires post-processing with AgX tone mapping.
screen.rtest.settings.post.rainBloomFogD: Requires post-processing and rain bloom fog.
screen.rtest.settings.post.dofSamples.re: Requires post-processing and depth of field.
screen.rtest.settings.post.manualFocusDe: Requires post-processing and depth of field. Disable autofocus to adjust.
screen.rtest.settings.post.agxMaxEV.requ: Requires post-processing with AgX tone mapping.
screen.rtest.settings.post.focalLength.r: Requires post-processing and depth of field.
screen.rtest.settings.post.agxLook.requi: Requires post-processing with AgX tone mapping.
screen.rtest.settings.post.apertureScale: Requires post-processing and depth of field.
screen.rtest.settings.post.maxBlurRadius: Requires post-processing and depth of field.
screen.rtest.settings.post.autofocus.req: Requires post-processing and depth of field.
screen.rtest.settings.skyboxTextureOpaci: Requires skybox texture with daylight opacity disabled.
screen.rtest.settings.emissionScale.tip: Scales base radiance from vanilla block lights, lava, emissive items, render layers and particles; zero disables base emission. Vanilla lights with PBR maps also use this lighting calibration; PBR texture emission has a separate control. Close settings after editing to recapture existing terrain lights.
screen.rtest.settings.upscaler.tip: FSR3, DLSS Super Resolution, or DLSS + Ray Reconstruction. DLSS requires a supported NVIDIA RTX GPU; unsupported devices use FSR3. Both DLSS modes are experimental. Ray Reconstruction replaces NRD.
